messages:
alex m: Quick follow-up thread for Peregrine postmortem — main areas: VPC peering flaps + on-prem isolation race. Need owners and timelines so we can close action items.

julia ops: Copied the postmortem notes here. TL;DR: intermittent peering timeouts trigger a reconnect loop which exposes an ABA race in tenant-isolation controller; stale route entries then cause customer-visible isolation.

sanjay r: I can own the controller side fixes. Action items for me: (1) repro in staging, (2) patch controller to serialize KV sync windows, (3) add unit + integration tests. ETA? 

maria g: I'll own the network/vendor side — check onprem router firmware + config, and coordinate scheduling with the customer. Will aim to have initial vendor findings by end of week.

alex m: Assigning owners/timelines: sanjay r -> patch + tests by 2026-03-05; maria g -> vendor/firmware report by 2026-03-03; julia ops -> canary run and monitoring config next week.

julia ops: I'll set up a canary with 2 non-prod customers, mirror routes, and enable verbose peering logs. Also will add a Grafana panel for peering_error_rate and stale-route alerts.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster created 1718550000, metrics + logging enabled.

sanjay r: Quick repro note for the docs: requires sequence peer-flap -> rapid reconnect -> overlapping KV sync. Relevant log snippet: ```ERROR isolation-controller: stale-route detected after sync window``` — I'll paste fuller traces into the ticket.

alex m: Also proposing a resilience play: add a short debounce before forcing route cleanup and a safelist for recently-restarted peers. Sanjay, can you add a proposal doc and cost/latency tradeoffs?

sanjay r: Added RW-3456: "chaos: vpc-peer blip test + controller debounce". Owner sanjay r, estimate 2d to implement tests + PR.

maria g: Vendor response: firmware 1.2.8 addresses some timeout handling and adds a "graceful-peering" flag. They recommend enabling it for Peregrine's router model; requires maintenance window to flip.

julia ops: Updated the action tracker (sheet + internal ticket). Short list of follow-ups in tracker: owners, PR links, canary start, vendor window. I'll loop in CS to propose customer maintenance slots.

alex m: :thumbsup: Reconvene sync scheduled 2026-03-06 10:00 PT to review patch + canary results. We want 72h clean before closing actions.

sanjay r: Noted — will post PR link and test logs here when ready.

julia ops: Also adding a recurring alert rule: 7-day rolling peering-flap analysis. If spikes >3 in 24h, auto-create incident for triage.

maria g: I'll confirm maintenance window with customer and vendor. If customer cannot schedule, we need a fallback plan for config-level mitigations.

alex m: Thanks all. If anyone picks up additional blockers, drop them here. Otherwise we'll mark progress in the action tracker and close items post-verification.
